notes:
StreamMate 0.11.0 (460681)
The playback card now shows the current programme synopsis when available. Long descriptions expand on demand. Favorite and Hide from suggestions share one row. The stream picker offers artwork retry only when needed.
Sports and Home favorite carousels show distinct positions, and the Sports possible-channels chooser uses the frosted treatment. Favorite and LIVE poster badges align at different font sizes.
Tested on phone and TV emulators with synthetic listings. A phone emulator recorded focus timeouts during validation. Physical device and private provider behavior still need confirmation. On the tested Android 15 launcher, Home entered picture-in-picture; switching directly to another app from Recents did not.
